\section{\texttt{stream\_ingest}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.cli.stream_ingest}\index{Functions!stream\_ingest}

\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]

\end{lstlisting}

\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{input}] \texttt{Annotated[Path,\allowbreak{} typer.\allowbreak{}Option(help='JSONL stream file of feedback events.\allowbreak{}')\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}}, required.
  \item[\texttt{output}] \texttt{Annotated[Path,\allowbreak{} typer.\allowbreak{}Option(help='CSV path for accepted feedback records.\allowbreak{}')\allowbreak{}]\allowbreak{}}, default \texttt{Path('.\allowbreak{}artifacts/\allowbreak{}stream\_\allowbreak{}feedback.\allowbreak{}csv')\allowbreak{}}.
